records.text: All of Charlie Kirk's security personnel on the day of his assassination, including Rick Cutler, Dan Flood, and Brian Harpole, were from Texas.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Oddly, all of Charlie's security that day was from Texas, from Rick Cutler to Dan Flood, even Brian Harpole.

verification.notes: Reporting confirms Brian Harpole, Dan Flood, and Rick Cutler were present in or associated with Kirk's security response, and public material gives each Texas ties. However, live research did not establish that these three were the entire security staff or that every security person that day was from Texas; the universal claim cannot be confirmed.

records.text: Brian Harpole said the vehicle traveled at 60, 80, and 100 miles per hour with a door open while Rick Cutler held him and he treated Charlie Kirk.
records.speaker: Brian Harpole

appearances.snippet: And so I'm on my knees with the door open with my butt hanging out of the side and I'm on my knees doing the medical and Justin (Justin Davis)'s driving, you know, we're going 60, 80, 100 and Rick (Rick Cutler) has me.

verification.notes: The full interview transcript records Harpole saying the SUV traveled at 60, 80, and 100 while the door was open, he worked on his knees, and Rick held him so he would not fall out. This verifies the attribution, not the independent accuracy of the speed estimates.

records.text: The left rear door where Rick Cutler sat was relatively clean immediately after the incident, with visible blood only at the handle.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And again, I'd like to note that this glove is located inside of the left side rear doors where Rick Cutler was seated. ... This is not after the car is cleaned up. And I can make that apparent in the next picture. ... Anyway, the only place that we could see blood on this door was just there at the handle, so we're zooming in so you can see that.

verification.notes: The public episode displays a photo of a mostly clean rear door with an apparent stain near the handle, supporting the visual description. The image alone does not independently authenticate when it was taken, which vehicle door it depicts, or who occupied that seat, so the immediate-aftermath and Rick Cutler provenance portions remain unconfirmed.

records.text: Owens said she had been told that Rick Cutler was among those who removed their own clothes at the hospital, and that federal agents allegedly collected the removed clothing, down to boxer briefs.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, we also told you that Rick (Rick Cutler) was among those who allegedly stripped down his clothes at the hospital. I think that's something obviously Frank (Frank Turek) has been open about. ... But we were also told that the feds were the ones who allegedly took those clothes thereafter down to his boxer briefs, allegedly.

verification.notes: Corrected a role-reversal extraction error: the local transcript and public episode transcript describe security staff removing their own clothing, not removing Kirk's clothing. Search results repeat the on-channel allegation but did not provide an independent collection inventory or first-party record confirming Cutler's clothing seizure. The public transcript establishes what Owens alleged, not that federal agents collected these items. Replaces the earlier true/high label that overlooked the normalized-text error.
